targets.authors: Soto D, Mäntylä T, Silvanto J
targets.title: Working memory without consciousness
targets.evidence_quote: The aim of the present Registered Report is to test whether WM can operate unconsciously by replicating the original study of  Soto et al. (2011)  with a highly powered multisite sample.
targets.outcome_quote: Our fixed intercept of .552 in proportion units was associated with a significant  p -value, indicating that WM performance is above chance in  unseen cue-present  trials and, in turn, that Soto et al.’s finding was replicated. In their experiments, Soto et al. did not find a significant correlation ( r  = −.18,  p  = .41), but we did ( r  = .228,  p  < .001). The reason why we did not reproduce Soto et al.’s null correlation is possibly due to their comparatively lower power (only 22 participants) which did not allow them to detect the subtle but significant correlation.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors confirm above-chance unconscious working memory and the positive intercept, but explicitly do not replicate the original null correlation. Confirmation of the principal effect is a comparison rather than a verdict on the replication as a whole.

reasoning: New multisite participant data re-test Soto et al. (2011). The meta-analysis reanalysis motivates the replication and is not a separate target.
